title: piSession: evict idle SessionHandles (map only grows)
description: PiSessionManager.handles is never evicted at runtime; disposeAll() runs only at process shutdown. Fix: after closeTurn (or on a timer), dispose handles idle for N minutes; safe because open() re-seeds history from the store on reopen.

title: Server turn-status rehydration: UI should ask backend if a turn is running (refresh survival)
description: After a browser refresh the 'preparing…' indicator is gone because phase/streaming are client-side drawer state set by send(); the server keeps running the turn unobserved. Fix (part of subscribe-all WS work, MVP slice): on drawer creation / loadHistory, get 'is a turn running for this key' from the server (e.g. sessionStatus in GET /api/view payload or a status frame on WS subscribe) and derive phase/streaming from that instead of only local send() state.

title: Thinking pill shows ALL ladder levels instead of the model's supported ones
description: Bug: Composer.vue availableLevels does Object.keys(map) on thinkingLevelMap, but thinkingLevelMapForEfforts() puts EVERY ladder level in the map with null for unsupported ones — so all 6 levels always show. Fix: filter to map[k] != null (keys where the value is non-null). While in commandCode.ts, add missing MODEL_REASONING entries for Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash and z-ai/glm-5.3-flash (they have MODEL_EFFORTS but no MODEL_REASONING).

title: ChatView: show loading state while history fetches (single-click open bug)
description: Bug: on selectSession, App.vue fire-and-forgets chat.loadHistory(key); until it resolves the drawer has messages:[] so ChatView shows the empty-state, and races/errors make the user click twice. Fix: add loading:boolean to LiveState in src/state/chat.ts (set true at start of loadHistory, false in finally), expose it, and have ChatView render a 'loading conversation…' state when loading is true instead of the empty hero.

title: ZDR: seed toggle state from server + fix offline toggle flip
description: Two nits from the build-a9c review: (1) zdrOn in src/state/backend.ts is ref(true) and never read from the server — on reload the sidebar shows ZDR on even when it's off. Seed it in refreshView (return zdr in GET /api/view or add GET /api/sessions/zdr). (2) toggleZdr flips the UI optimistically even when conn !== ok, with no request and no rollback — flip after the conn check or surface the offline state.

title: Frontend refactor: split App.vue god component (parallel-conversation prep, slice 1)
description:
## Goal

Refactor the frontend (src/) out of the App.vue god component so that
parallel conversations (multiple chats streaming at once) become a state-model
change instead of a rewrite. This is slice 1 of the plan in
direction/parallel-chat-arch/notes.txt — land it BEFORE the server TurnRunner
work and the WS subscribe-protocol change, so the wire change lands on the new
structure.

## Scope decisions (agreed with owner 2026-08-27)

- Keep the file name `src/data/domain.ts` (no rename to types.ts).
- Split domain.ts: types + domain rules stay; demo-only data (seed projects /
  seed sessions / messagesBySession / mockReply) moves out of the shared file.
- No `transport/` abstraction. Demo/real branching is removed structurally:
  every action that branches on `conn` must be written so the demo path is a
  single delegated call (or an explicit out-of-scope note), not an interleaved
  fork in App.vue.
- useChat (or its successor) holds per-session live state:
  Map<sessionKey, LiveState> where LiveState = { messages, liveText, phase,
  streaming, turn handle }. Consequence: switching sessions no longer aborts
  the other stream — it keeps streaming in the background (minimum
  parallel-correct behavior; the one observable behavior change in this slice).
- The raw fetch("/api/sessions/zdr") in App.vue moves into projectsApi.ts.
- ChatView dead CSS already deleted (2026-08-27 commit work: one live override
  kept — `.chat-body.is-empty .composer { margin: auto }`).

## Deliberately NOT in this slice

- Wire/protocol changes (chatSocket stays one-socket-per-turn; server untouched)
- Parallel multi-visible UI (step 4)
- CSS tokens / component split cosmetic pass
- Sidebar live/streaming indicators (state now supports them; UI later)

## Acceptance criteria

- vue-tsc build passes (pnpm build).
- Manual smoke (pnpm dev + npx tsx server/index.ts): real mode — send, stream,
  stop, switch sessions mid-stream (other stream continues), send in second
  thread; demo mode (backend down) — seed data + mock reply flow.
- App.vue script reduced to thin wiring (target < ~100 lines).
- No interleaved demo/real forks remain in the extracted modules.

## Context
Plan: direction/parallel-chat-arch/notes.txt (entries of 2026-08-27). Blocks nothing yet; should land before the WS subscribe-protocol change so that change targets the new structure. Server-side TurnRunner (per-key queue, one in-flight turn per conversation) is a separate ticket and is not blocked by this refactor.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build passes; real-mode smoke (send/stream/stop/switch-continues/2nd-thread) and demo-mode smoke both work; App.vue script < ~100 lines; no interleaved demo/real forks in extracted modules
notes: Scope change (owner, 2026-08-27): demo mode is DELETED, not moved. Removes: seed projects/sessions, messagesBySession, mockReply, mock streaming timers, sendMock/finalizeMock/abortMock, all 'if conn !== ok' forks in actions, 'demo' from the conn state (conn = ok|loading|error; drops --conn-demo + data-conn=demo styles in Sidebar/SettingsModal). Consequence: backend down = empty sidebar + error dot; add a small 'no connection' empty-state card in the sidebar. Module split confirmed: sessions.ts / chat.ts / backend.ts. No transport abstraction. chat.ts = one startTurn(key, text) per-key drawer (Map<sessionKey, LiveState>); switching sessions no longer aborts other streams.

title: Design: model picker + thinking pill (composer) + ZDR global (sidebar)
description: Refines build-gw6.5 with a pattern-consistent design (agreed with owner 2026-08-24). ZDR is GLOBAL (manager-level, unchanged) and moves to the SIDEBAR (replaces the gear). Model picker + thinking control live in the CHAT COMPOSER at the BOTTOM: input shell (＋ attach stub, auto-grow textarea, send ↑ arrow bottom-right → ■ stop while streaming) over a control row ([Model ▾] and [thinking: off ▾], click + Shift+Tab cycle). Per-session model + thinking PERSIST via the event-sourced store (extend the existing session.state/session.noInbox pattern: new model_id/thinking_level cols + session.model/session.thinking events; getSessions returns them). Full design in PLAN_model_picker.md.
design:
# Design: model picker + thinking pill (chat composer) + ZDR global (sidebar)

Refines **build-gw6.5** with a pattern-consistent design. ZDR is **global** (manager-level),
moved to the **sidebar**; model picker + thinking control live in the **chat composer**.

## Agreed decisions
- **ZDR = global**, stays in the manager (no per-session). Toggle moves to the **sidebar**
  (replaces the ⚙ gear); the connection dot stays.
- **Model picker + thinking control live in the chat composer**, at the **bottom**:
  - **Input shell** (top): `＋` attach (stub), auto-grow textarea (Enter=send, Shift+Enter=NL),
    **send ↑ arrow bottom-right → ■ stop while streaming**.
  - **Control row** (bottom, below input): `[Model ▾]` and `[thinking: off ▾]`.
- **Per-session model + thinking persist** (survive reload) via the event-sourced store.
- **`＋` attach** = stub (native file picker; image→model wiring is phase-2 per gw6).

## Data flow
```
Sidebar  [ZDR ●/○]  → POST /api/sessions/zdr (global, unchanged)
Composer [Model ▾][thinking ▾] + [+ input ↑]
   → PATCH /api/sessions/:key/model   {model}
   → PATCH /api/sessions/:key/thinking {level}
   → GET /api/models  (catalog w/ thinkingLevelMap)
App.vue holds models[], current session modelId/thinkingLevel; PATCH on change (optimistic).
manager.open(key): read stored modelId/thinkingLevel → session.setModel()/setThinkingLevel() before prompt().
```

## Backend
### `id` clarification (verified against live /provider/v1/models)
The API returns `{object:"list", data:[{id, object, created, owned_by, name, context_length}]}`.
**`id` is the OpenAI-compatible model slug** sent to `/chat/completions`
(e.g. `claude-sonnet-5`, `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash`). Our `commandCode.ts` already maps it
correctly (`id: m.id`). `getModels()` returns `{id, name, reasoning, input, thinkingLevelMap}` —
`id` is that slug, exactly what `modelRuntime.getModel(provider, id)` expects. ✅
`reasoning` and `thinkingLevelMap` are **derived** from the static `MODEL_EFFORTS` table
(the API does not expose them) — no change to id semantics.

### `manager.getModels()` (server/piSession.ts)
- Cache the fetched catalog: store `this.models` from `fetchModels()` (today it's a local var in
  `registerCommandCode` — promote to an instance field so `getModels()` can read it).
- `getModels()` returns `this.models.map(m => ({ id: m.id, name: m.name,
  reasoning: <MODEL_EFFORTS has id>, input: inputModalitiesForModel(m.id),
  thinkingLevelMap: thinkingMetadataForModel(m.id)?.thinkingLevelMap }))`.
  This is **pure composition** over existing `commandCode.ts` helpers — no new model logic.

### Store change is the *only* core change — and it is pattern-consistent (NOT a "patch")
`stateStore.ts` already supports per-session attributes via the event-sourcing pattern:
`session.state` and `session.noInbox` are domain events → `projection_sessions` columns.
We **extend that exact pattern**:
- New columns: `model_id TEXT`, `thinking_level TEXT` on `projection_sessions`.
- New domain events: `session.model {sessionKey, modelId}`, `session.thinking {sessionKey, level}`
  (added to the `DomainEvent` union; `applyEvent` handles them like the existing two).
- `getSessions` returns `modelId`/`thinkingLevel` (it already returns the projection row).
This is the established extension mechanism of an event-sourced store — not special-casing.
ZDR stays out of the store (global).

### Routes (server/routes/sessions.ts)
- `GET /api/models` → `manager.getModels()`.
- `PATCH /api/sessions/:key/model` `{model}` → `store.write({type:"session.model", ...})`
  (shape mirrors `session.noInbox`).
- `PATCH /api/sessions/:key/thinking` `{level}` → `store.write({type:"session.thinking", ...})`.
- Global `POST /api/sessions/zdr` stays as-is.

### Apply on open (server/piSession.ts)
`open(key)` reads `store.getSession(key).modelId`/`thinkingLevel` (default model per existing
default; default thinking `off`) and calls `session.setModel(getModel(provider, id))` +
`session.setThinkingLevel(level)` before `prompt()`.

## Frontend
### Sidebar.vue
Remove ⚙ gear; add `[ZDR ●/○]` toggle bound to a global `zdrOn` ref (POST /api/sessions/zdr).
Connection dot unchanged.

### Composer.vue (new)
Replaces the textarea/Send in ChatView footer. Structure:
- **Input shell** (top): `＋` (file picker stub), auto-grow textarea (Enter=send,
  Shift+Enter=NL), **send ↑ arrow bottom-right → ■ stop while streaming**.
- **Control row** (bottom, below input): `[Model ▾]` dropdown (from `models`),
  `[thinking: off ▾]` pill that cycles `["off", ...Object.keys(thinkingLevelMap)]`
  (click + Shift+Tab; disabled when model has no thinking).
- Emits: `send`, `abort`, `model(id)`, `thinking(level)`.

### ChatView.vue
Drop its ZDR button + old composer; mount `<Composer>` in footer; pass `models`, `modelId`,
`thinkingLevel`.

### App.vue (state ownership)
- Fetch `/api/models` once → `models[]`.
- Hold per-session `modelId`/`thinkingLevel`, seeded from the enriched session object;
  on Composer `model`/`thinking` emit → optimistic update + `api.setSessionModel/Thinking`.
  Survives reload (store owns it).

### projectsApi.ts — placement
Pure HTTP transport, **same shape as existing `setNoInbox(key, bool)` / `setSessionState(key, State)`**:
- `getModels()`
- `setSessionModel(key, modelId)`
- `setSessionThinking(key, level)`
(App.vue owns state + calls these; components emit intent only.)

### data/mock.ts → rename (refactor, separate bead)
No longer mock data; holds domain types (`Project/Session/Message/State`) + seed.
Rename to `src/data/domain.ts` (or `types.ts`) and update ~all imports. Mechanical;
tracked separately from the feature.

## Out of scope / deferred
- 422 `cmd_zdr_no_providers` toast (follow-up bead; picker/thinking don't need it).
- Image attach → model input wiring (phase-2 per gw6).
- Per-conversation ZDR (explicitly deferred; global only now).

## Open questions
1. `data/mock.ts` rename target: `domain.ts` vs `types.ts`?
2. SettingsModal (edits backend URL) is orphaned by removing ⚙. Keep a minimal access
   (long-press connection dot / tiny ⋯) or drop entirely?

## Subtask breakdown (spawn as child beads when starting work)
1. Spike: confirm `AgentSession.setModel()` + `getAvailableThinkingLevels()` behave as assumed.
2. Backend: `manager.getModels()` + cache `this.models`; `GET /api/models`.
3. Backend: store `model_id`/`thinking_level` + `session.model`/`session.thinking` events;
   `getSessions` returns them.
4. Backend: `PATCH /api/sessions/:key/model` + `/thinking`; apply in `open()`.
5. Frontend: `projectsApi.ts` `getModels/setSessionModel/setSessionThinking`.
6. Frontend: `Composer.vue` (input shell + control row); mount in `ChatView`; drop ZDR button there.
7. Frontend: Sidebar ZDR toggle (replace ⚙); App.vue state ownership + wiring; Shift+Tab cycle.
8. Refactor: rename `data/mock.ts` → `data/domain.ts` + update imports.
9. Deferred: 422 toast; image attach wiring.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc (PLAN_model_picker.md) is the agreed source of truth; owner approves the placement (ZDR sidebar, picker/thinking composer-bottom) and the store extension approach; subtasks spawn as child beads when work begins.

title: Chat window: show thinking + tool-call progress frames (live status)
description:
The WS channel currently forwards only text_delta/text_end (relay.ts). During reasoning tokens, tool calls, and long model thinking, NOTHING flows to the browser — the chat looks frozen while the backend is alive. This is a large share of the 'streaming gets stuck' feeling and is needed before/alongside coalescing (build-359) so 1s-cadence streaming never looks dead.

DESIGN (owner-finalized direction, details to confirm during build):
- Relay additionally captures thinking_start/thinking_delta/thinking_end and tool_execution_start/update/end (pi AgentSession emits these; see server/bus.ts kinds today: message.sent|message.delta|message.end).
- New bus kinds / ServerFrames, e.g. {type:'thinking.delta', text} and {type:'tool.status', tool, phase} — throttled/coalesced to the same ~1s cadence as build-359.
- Browser renders a subtle 'thinking…' indicator (e.g. italic gray block or inline pulse) and a compact tool-call line (tool name + status), NOT full markdown.
- Out of scope: displaying tool arguments/results inline, subagent trees, steer — those stay later phases (contracts mark tool_call as 'later phase').

FILES: server/relay.ts, server/bus.ts, server/routes/chat.ts, src/api/chatSocket.ts (frame types), src/components/ChatView.vue (render).

title: Streaming coalescing: batch WS deltas + sqlite writes to ~1 frame/sec
description:
Slow the chat stream from one frame per token (70/sec) to calm ~1 frame per second by buffering deltas in memory before pushing to the browser AND before persisting.

WHY: model emits ~70 tps but the browser feels ~10 tps and gets stuck. Root cause is round-trip count, not volume: relay.ts does one store.write() per text_delta (4 SQL ops each: log INSERT + SELECT MAX(idx) + message UPSERT re-reading+concatenating the full text + session touch) and chat.ts pushes one tiny WS frame per token through nginx + Cloudflare tunnel. The projections table is NOT in the live path (persist-first → in-memory bus → WS), so this is purely a batching change.

DESIGN (ideation finalized with owner):
- Persist semantics unchanged: every chunk commits to sqlite BEFORE its WS frame leaves (persist-first invariant stays).
- Relay coalesces: accumulate deltas in a per-turn buffer; flush every ~1s OR when buffer reaches ~100 chars OR on first-flush (flush as soon as we have a sentence-ish chunk so the UI is not blank for a full second).
- Flush writes ONE message.sent (streaming:true, text=chunk) to the store and emits one message.delta on the bus → one WS frame. Final text_end still REPLACES in the projection (existing rule).
- ABORT: flush the remaining buffer before settling, so up to 1s of generated text is not lost on Stop.
- Client (App.vue onDelta / chatSocket) unchanged in this ticket — it already just appends text; the frame cadence change is server-side only.

FILES: server/relay.ts (+ likely chat.ts untouched). ~30 lines.

EXPLICIT NON-GOALS (phase 2, separate beads): markdown re-render optimization (App.vue+MarkdownView, O(n^2) re-parse per token — deferred until owner feels it after this), thinking/tool-call progress frames (separate bead), configurable interval knob.
notes: Implemented. relay.ts now coalesces text_delta into a 1s in-memory buffer; each flush = one store.write(streaming:true) + one bus emit (one WS frame/sec). text_end clears interval, drops buffer, writes full text (REPLACES in projection). Abort/first-flush/client untouched per owner. tsc clean; simulated relay test: 5 deltas → 2 writes (1 chunk + final), streamedText intact.

title: Delete Ollama: strip pi-ollama-cloud refs (backend + deploy + docs)
description: Depends on build-gw6.4 (which removes the imports from piSession.ts). Remove the pi-ollama-cloud dependency from package.json (npm uninstall pi-ollama-cloud), strip OLLAMA_API_KEY / OLLAMA_BASE / GENERATED_MODELS / refreshOllamaCatalog / provider='ollama-cloud' references from deploy/start.sh and docs (direction/*.md, README, CONTEXT.md), and update the run instructions to COMMANDCODE_API_KEY.

title: UI: model picker + thinking pill + ZDR toggle (chat header)
description:
Depends on build-gw6.4 (backend wiring) + build-gw6.3 (ZDR decision). Frontend changes:

  - GET /api/models returns ALL models (reasoning, input, thinkingLevelMap).
  - PATCH /api/sessions/:key/model|thinking|zdr -> session.setModel()/setThinkingLevel()/setZdr().
  - Chat header shows: [Model v] [thinking pill off/low/medium/high/xhigh] [ZDR o/●].
  - Shift+Tab cycles Object.keys(thinkingLevelMap).
  - ZDR toggle flips default model for NEW sessions (off -> muse spark 1.2 contributor, on -> deepseek-v4-flash); existing session keeps its model until picker change.
  - 422 cmd_zdr_no_providers -> toast.

Files: src/components/ChatHeader.vue + src/api/projectsApi.ts (and a new models endpoint route likely).
acceptance_criteria: Header renders [Model v] [thinking pill] [ZDR o/●]; Shift+Tab cycles thinkingLevelMap keys; toggling ZDR flips the header and the next WS request carries/omits x-cmd-zdr:1; 422 shows a toast; model picker change persists per session and survives reload.

title: PiSessionManager: wire command-code provider + thinking + ZDR state
description:
Depends on build-gw6.1 (constants), build-gw6.2 (catalog+cache), build-gw6.3 (ZDR decision). Wire the provider + thinking + ZDR into server/piSession.ts.

SCOPE:
  - Replace GENERATED_MODELS / OLLAMA_BASE / refreshOllamaCatalog imports from pi-ollama-cloud with our vendored commandCode module + catalog cache (agentDir + cwd injection per build-gw6.2).
  - ModelRuntime.registerProvider('command-code', { name, baseUrl, apiKey: '', api: 'openai-completions', models, refreshModels }) + setRuntimeApiKey('command-code', process.env.COMMANDCODE_API_KEY ?? '')
  - resolveModel('command-code', session.modelId) — session handle carries modelId; default per ZDR: off -> muse spark 1.2 contributor, on -> deepseek-v4-flash.
  - toAgentMessages provider: 'command-code'
  - session.setModel() / setThinkingLevel() / cycleThinkingLevel() / getThinkingLevel() wired through from routes + store; thinking_level_changed event on the bus.
  - session handle exposes per-conversation zdr getter/setter used by chat.ts per request; 422 cmd_zdr_no_providers surfaced as an error event.

The extension pi-commandcode-provider is NOT installed; all provider logic stays vendored. Keeep pi-ollama-cloud import removed in the SAME commit that wires command-code (the milestone is one-SIGINT-free swap, not both providers available).
acceptance_criteria: No pi-ollama-cloud imports remain (grep -r ollama server/ deploy/ src/ docs/ is clean); a WS prompt with COMMANDCODE_API_KEY set streams end-to-end via provider command-code; /api/models lists ALL Command Code models; setThinkingLevel / cycleThinkingLevel / getThinkingLevel work per session; thinking_level_changed event emitted; 422 cmd_zdr_no_providers -> error event.

title: CommandCode ZDR header hook — placement decision
description:
DECISION NEEDED (no code yet). build-gw6 change 4 wants per-conversation ZDR toggle -> x-cmd-zdr:1 injected per request. The Provider API is OpenAI-compatible at /provider/v1/chat/completions, so modelRuntime.streamSimple(...) goes through pi-ai's openai-completions path. How to inject the header per request?

CONTENDERS:
  1. ModelRuntime.streamSimple(..., { transformHeaders }) — pi-ai ModelsRequestTransforms.transformHeaders runs per stream call, BEFORE provider dispatch, and can add/overwrite headers. BUT it applies per CALL, not per model; to make it per-conversation we'd need to pass it through every prompt() call site (chat.ts) and know the session's current zdr state there. Session state lives in piSession.ts (manager) — chat.ts would need a getter like manager.getZdr(sessionKey). Also the header is a REQUEST-level concern; on 422 cmd_zdr_no_providers we need to surface a toast — that requires error plumbing out of the stream (an error event type on the relay/subscription bus, not just a header).
  2. BeforeProviderHeaders extension event — pi's extension event runs once per request with the merged headers; but we are NOT installing the extension (we're vendoring), so no BeforeProviderHeaders handler exists in our process. Would require wiring an extension runner into createAgentSession — heavier, against the vendor decision.
  3. Per-model headers on ProviderConfigInput.models[].headers — static per model, can't be toggled per conversation without re-registering the provider on every toggle.

Also to decide: where does the zdr flag live? A boolean on projection_sessions (default CMD_ZDR_DEFAULT) means the store owns it; piSession manager reads/writes it via store methods; chat.ts must consult it per request. Alternative: keep zdr in the session handle (manager) and persist separately. RECOMMENDED (my leaning): option 1 (transformHeaders) with a manager.getZdr(sessionKey) consulted per prompt; store owns persistence; error mapping 422 -> toast handled in chat.ts / relay.

Produce a short ADR in this issue's notes (or a decision file) and close. This DECISION bead gates build-gw6.3 (piSession wiring) and build-gw6.5 (UI toggle).
acceptance_criteria: A short ADR records the chosen injection mechanism (recommend transformHeaders + manager.getZdr), the persistence owner (projection_sessions), and the 422->toast mapping; the decision bead is CLOSED so build-gw6.3 and build-gw6.5 can proceed.
notes:
DECISION (user, 2026-08-23) — ZDR button mechanism.

RESEARCH (commandcode.ai/docs/provider + pi-commandcode-provider main):
- x-cmd-zdr: 1 is a plain REQUEST HEADER on the OpenAI-compatible
  /provider/v1/chat/completions endpoint. ZDR is NOT a session concept:
  the header is stateless and per-request. The CLI exposes it as the
  CMD_ZDR=1 env var; the pi extension exposes COMMANDCODE_ZDR=1 and injects
  { "x-cmd-zdr": "1" } into the provider's static `headers` at register time.
- 422 cmd_zdr_no_providers: when the header is set but the chosen model has
  no ZDR-capable upstream, the request fails 422 rather than falling back.
- ZDR can change which upstream serves the request, so it may cost more.

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR US:
- No special "hook" is needed. The header rides along on every chat request.
- Per-conversation toggle = keep the header presence per session. Since pi's
  registered provider config has STATIC headers, the per-session flip cannot
  live in the provider config. It must be injected per REQUEST.
- pi API surface: ModelRuntime.streamSimple(..., { transformHeaders }) runs
  per stream call, before dispatch, and can add/overwrite headers. That is
  the per-request injection point. It needs to know the session's zdr state.

FINAL DESIGN (how the button works end to end):
1. Persistence: boolean `zdr` on projection_sessions (default CMD_ZDR_DEFAULT
   env, default false). StateStore owns it (new domain event session.zdr +
   column + upsert), mirroring the existing session.noInbox pattern.
2. API: PATCH /api/sessions/:key/zdr { zdr: boolean } -> store.write().
3. Button: ChatHeader.vue single toggle. On click -> PATCH -> header shows
   ZDR o (off) / ● (on).
4. Request path: chat.ts (WS /api/chat/:key) reads manager.getZdr(sessionKey)
   and passes transformHeaders: (h) => zdr ? { ...h, "x-cmd-zdr": "1" } : h
   into the session prompt stream. No code in commandCode.ts needed.
5. Default model flip (off -> muse spark 1.2 contributor, on -> deepseek-v4-flash)
   is a side effect in the PATCH handler / session create — NOT in the header.
6. 422 cmd_zdr_no_providers: relay/chat maps the error to a toast event.
7. Non-goal: ZDR has NOTHING to do with inbox. Per-conversation only.

Files touched (in gw6.4/gw6.5, not now): stateStore.ts (zdr column+event),
routes/sessions.ts (PATCH zdr), routes/chat.ts (transformHeaders),
ChatHeader.vue + projectsApi.ts (button).

title: CommandCode catalog cache + fetch (no streaming)
description:
From pi-commandcode-provider@0.5.1 models.ts, implement the catalog-layer parts of server/commandCode.ts (use the code as reference, licensed MIT, zero-dep). Depends: build-gw6.1 (constants).

SCOPE (server/commandCode.ts addition):
  - fetchCommandCodeModels(): GET COMMANDCODE_API_BASE/models (default https://api.commandcode.ai/provider/v1, 10s timeout via runWithTimeout, abort-aware, 'object' must be 'list')
  - parse + validation (positiveNumberField / booleanField / stringField), map to CommandCodeModel[]
  - commandCodeModelsFromApiResponse / commandCodeModelsFromCache (cache versioning)
  - loadCommandCodeModels(): live -> cache file <agentDir>/commandcode-models.json ; on failure fall back to cache / empty (mirror the 'live' | 'cache' | 'empty' + warning result)
  - coalesced refreshPromise: callers share ONE in-flight refresh; a refreshModels() entry point returns the shared promise
  - refreshModels cooldown: a loaded-at timestamp; a repeated refreshModels() within the cooldown window returns the cached models without a network hit (10s cooldown)
  - default export uses the env base URL; create() in piSession.ts injects agentDir + cwd for the cache path

NOT in scope: streaming/chat (that is build-gw6.3 piSession wiring), ZDR header injection (deliberating), auth (apiKey injection is build-gw6.3), thinking level cycling (UI).
acceptance_criteria: Given COMMANDCODE_API_KEY set ~> fetch succeeds with no cache; given offline or 10s timeout ~> falls back to cache file if valid, else returns empty result + warning; a second loadCommandCodeModels() within 10s returns cache without network (spy on global fetch); no streaming or headers touched; npx tsx server/commandCode.ts runs standalone.

title: Swap provider ollama-cloud -> command-code (OpenAI-compatible models + per-conversation ZDR toggle + thinking levels + UI model picker)
description:
## Context
`server/piSession.ts` is hard-wired to `pi-ollama-cloud` (OLLAMA_BASE=https://ollama.com/v1, GENERATED_MODELS 18 static entries, OLLAMA_API_KEY, provider="ollama-cloud"). Command Code Provider API is OpenAI-compatible at https://api.commandcode.ai/provider/v1 (/chat/completions, /models) with per-request `x-cmd-zdr:1` (422 cmd_zdr_no_providers when no ZDR upstream). `pi-commandcode-provider` exists not for baseUrl alone but for: live catalog GET /provider/v1/models + file cache (commandcode-models.json), COMMANDCODE_API_KEY / ~/.commandcode/auth.json auth (we want headless, no browser /login), per-model compat + thinkingLevelMap, x-cmd-zdr injection via BeforeProviderHeaders, image gating, pricing table. We will vendor that logic in server/commandCode.ts, not install the extension. Note: Shift+Tab showing no thinking levels is a local-machine (pi harness) issue, not a project bug — this feature integrates thinking levels properly via our own thinkingLevelMap.

## Change
1. Delete Ollama — remove pi-ollama-cloud dep, OLLAMA_API_KEY/OLLAMA_BASE/refreshOllamaCatalog/GENERATED_MODELS refs in server/piSession.ts, deploy/start.sh, docs.
2. Own server/commandCode.ts — COMMANDCODE_API_BASE (default https://api.commandcode.ai/provider/v1), fetchJsonWithTimeout(10s) GET /models, file cache <agentDir>/commandcode-models.json with coalesced refresh, refreshModels cooldown. Maps to ProviderModelConfig[] with correct per-family compat + thinkingLevelMap (from GOAT plan). No whitelist — expose ALL available Command Code models; user picks directly in UI via GET /api/models + pi ModelRuntime.
3. Wire PiSessionManager — ModelRuntime.registerProvider("command-code", {baseUrl, api:"openai-completions", models, refreshModels}), setRuntimeApiKey("command-code", process.env.COMMANDCODE_API_KEY), resolveModel("command-code", session.modelId), toAgentMessages provider:"command-code", expose setThinkingLevel/cycleThinkingLevel/getThinkingLevel + thinking_level_changed event.
4. ZDR toggle (per-conversation) — boolean on projection_sessions (default from CMD_ZDR_DEFAULT env). Single on/off button in chat header. When true, add x-cmd-zdr:1 per request. ZDR has nothing to do with inbox — per-conversation only. Flipping ZDR flips default model for new sessions: off -> muse spark 1.2 contributor, on -> deepseek-v4-flash (with mimo-v2.5 for images and mimo-v2.5-pro as reviewer available in the same lane). Existing session keeps its model until picker change. Handle 422 cmd_zdr_no_providers -> toast.
5. Model picker + thinking in UI — GET /api/models returns ALL models (reasoning, input, thinkingLevelMap). PATCH /api/sessions/:key/model|thinking|zdr -> session.setModel()/setThinkingLevel(). Header shows: [Model v] [thinking pill off/low/medium/high/xhigh] [ZDR o/●]. Shift+Tab cycles Object.keys(thinkingLevelMap). Thinking is tested locally without the pi-commandcode-provider plugin.
6. Docs cache — C:\Users\Public\Pi-coding_agent\Openclaw\commandcode\ populated from https://commandcode.ai/docs/llms.txt + /docs/provider + /models as local .md (offline read).

## Out of scope (phase 2)
Image attach auto-switch to mimo-v2.5, Claude/OpenAI closed models beyond GOAT open lane, browser OAuth login, pi install npm:pi-commandcode-provider as CLI extension, inbox-specific ZDR.

## Touchpoints (deferred)
server/commandCode.ts (new), server/piSession.ts, server/routes/sessions.ts + chat.ts, server/index.ts, package.json, deploy/start.sh, src/components/ChatHeader.vue + src/api/projectsApi.ts, commandcode/*.md
acceptance_criteria: COMMANDCODE_API_KEY set -> one WS prompt streams via Command Code, no Ollama refs remain (grep -r ollama clean); GET /api/models lists ALL available Command Code models; picker + ZDR button render; ZDR on/off flips header and next request carries/omits x-cmd-zdr:1 (422 toast on miss); thinking pill cycles per GOAT plan levels and survives per-session
notes: 2026-08-27: Refreshed server/commandCode.ts catalog from command-code@1.15.1 -> 1.36.0 (verified vs npm dist/bundled/command-code-knowledge/reference/models.md and provider commandcode-catalog.ts @1.32.2). MODEL_EFFORTS: fixed claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 (was low..max, now omitted = auto depth), added deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp (high,max), google/gemini-3.7-flash (low..high), Qwen3.8-27B + Qwen3.8-Flash (low,medium,xhigh), xai/grok-4.6 (low..xhigh), z-ai/glm-5.3-flash + zai-org/GLM-5.3 (low,high,max). Added MODEL_REASONING (48 models, from provider catalog) so isReasoningModel no longer conflates 'no selectable effort' with 'does not reason'. MODEL_INPUT_MODALITIES: added deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp, gemini-3.7-flash, Qwen3.8-27B (image-capable per CLI catalog; grok-4.6/GLM-5.3/Qwen3.8-Flash left text-only — no image evidence upstream). tsc + pnpm build pass.

On ClientFrame {type:prompt}: recordUserMessage(store,key,text) [persist user msg, NOT published], manager.open(key, projectDirFor(key)), attachAssistantRelay(store,key,handle.session), await handle.session.prompt(text), await relay.finished, send {type:status,phase:idle}. On {type:abort}: handle.session.abort(), send {type:status,phase:aborted}. Ordering rule: persist (awaited) before publish; bus carries only assistant output.
